highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 updates the bundled Skia engine and restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies packages.
highlights_body: It also adds Tizen 10 native build and packaging support, keeping the platform assets aligned with current tooling.

bullets.lead: Skia core fork updated for m155
bullets.detail: Integrates the current m155 Skia fork cleanup so applications use the latest bundled rendering engine changes in the 4.155 line.
Restores discovery of system fonts when using the Linux NoDependencies packages, so text rendering can again resolve installed fonts without bundled native dependencies.
Builds and packages the Tizen native assets with the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain, keeping Tizen support current.
